help.title: MosaicView - DevmeH paq
help.intro: MosaicView lo'taHvIS, De'wI' mIllogh paqmey DaraQlaH 'ej DaDI'laH; veymeyvo' DalelnISbe'. 64 bit patmey neH Qap nIqHom.
help.open_files_content:
• « 'a'baqa' poSmoH » leQ yI'uy, pagh QorwaghDaq 'a'baqa' yIHoq 'ej yIchagh
• tu'qommey lo'laHbogh: CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT, PDF, mIlloghmey (JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, BMP, TIFF, GIF, ICO). EPUB 'a'baqa'mey DapoSmoHlaH je, 'ach mIlloghmeychaj neH lellu' (mu'mey buSHa'lu'). yIqIm: mojaqmey Doq (WEBP, TIFF, GIF, ICO…) CBZ/CBR laDwI' nIqHommey ngo' lo'laHbe'law'. 'ach motlh Qorgh MosaicView.
• PDF So'lu'bogh (poSmoHmeH chaw' ngoq poQlu'): 'a'baqa' SuqlaHbe' nIqHom, 'ej Qagh QIn 'anglu'.
• choHmeH Qanlu'bogh PDF (ghajwI' chaw' ngoq): motlh tenwalmey Suqlu'. 'a'baqa' ngaSwI' rapDaq velqa' ngaQHa'moHlu'bogh choqmeH DuH nob MosaicView.
• tenwalmey nIb jemghach: vey poSmoHlu'DI', tenwalmey nIbqu' (Hotlh Qagh joq muvghach Qagh) motlh perlu': mIllogh machchajDaq gho Doq mach 'anglu'. « tenwalmey nIb vu' » (« DI' » HIDjolev, majyang mIlloghDaq nIH 'uy, pagh mIllogh machDaq nIH 'uy) Qorwagh poSmoH: tenwalmey nIb ghommey tetlh 'ang, 'ej tenwal HochvaD wIvmeH leQ tu'lu', velqa'mey law'qu' DateqmeH.
• weQmoQnaQvo' Suq: weQmoQnaQ leghwI'lIjvo' mIllogh (pagh tenwal Daq) yIHoq 'ej majyang mIlloghDaq yIchagh, pagh Daq DaghItlhmeH « weQmoQnaQvo' Suq » yIlo' (« 'a'baqa' » HIDjolev, pagh majyang mIlloghDaq nIH 'uy). bertlhamDaq mIlloghmey chellu', Dachaghpu'bogh patlh lo'taHvIS.
help.mosaic_content:
mIllogh paqlIj tenwalmey Hoch 'ang majyang mIllogh, mIllogh machmey rur. DaneHchugh:
• tenwalmey DapatlhmoHqa'meH yIHoq 'ej yIchagh (tenwalmey mI' chu'moHlu', mI' chu'moHghach lo' chu'lu'bogh lo'taHvIS)
• tenwalmey law' yIwIv (Ctrl+'uy joq Shift+'uy)
• mIllogh mach tInghach yIlIS: SeHwI' joq Ctrl+rutlhHom yIlo'
• mIllogh mach Dung yIvIH, De' DaleghmeH: pong, 'a'baqa' ngI'ghach, roDSermey, HaStay' mI', DPI, qalmuS patlh; mIllogh qolvaD, mIlloghmeyDaj mI' je
• 'a'baqa'mey pong yIchoH: pongDaj yI'uy
• mIllogh paq 'a'baqa'mey (CBZ/CBR/CB7/CBT/PDF) Windows Explorervo' poSlu'bogh mIllogh paq latlhDaq yIHoq 'ej yIchagh, qoDchaj DamuvmeH
• mIllogh machmey 'anglu'bogh Hoch DawIvbogh 'a'baqa' ngaSwI'Daq yIlel (ra' So'lu'bogh: Ctrl+Alt+T neH lo'lu')
• majyang mIllogh mach yI'ang: majyang mIllogh nIHDaq vol (poQlu'be'), tenwalmey Hoch mach 'ang, 'ej letbaQ DaH Daq leghlu'bogh 'ang. mIllogh paqDaq DavIHmeH letbaQ yI'uy pagh yIHoq. « pat » HIDjolev pagh majyang mIlloghDaq nIH 'uy lo'taHvIS Dachu'laH.
help.manipulation_content:
• tenwalmey DapatlhmoHqa'meH yIHoq 'ej yIchagh
• DamuvmeH, mIllogh paq naQ latlh mIllogh paqDaq yIHoq 'ej yIchagh
• DuHmey (jIrmoHghach, teqghach, latlh je) DaleghmeH tenwalDaq nIH yI'uy
• leghwI' DapoSmoHmeH tenwalDaq cha'logh yI'uy
• tenwalmey mob DalelmeH Windows 'a'baqa' ngaSwI'Daq yIHoq, pagh Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V yIlo'
help.renumber_content:
tenwalmey mI' chu'moHmeH wej lo'mey nob MosaicView. mI' chu'moHghach leQ, HIDjolev (nIH 'uy), Dotlh tlhegh Degh je lo'taHvIS DawIvlaH; Hoq 'ej chagh lo'lu'DI', motlh mI' chu'moHlu' je:

• lo': ruQbe'lu'bogh tenwal law' jemghach (lo' motlh): cha' tenwal, wej tenwal, latlh je DajemmeH, tenwal Hoch juchghach poj nIqHom. vaj tenwalmey law' mI' chu'moHlu' (cha' tenwal: 003-004; wej tenwal: 005-006-007). loS tenwalmey juSchugh, mI' wa'DIch mI' Qav je neH 'anglu' (010---025).

• lo': mI'mey nap: tenwal HochvaD mI' wa' nob nIqHom (001, 002, 003...); tenwalmey juchghach buSHa'.

• lo': chu'Ha'lu': mI' chu'moHghach ruQbe'lu'bogh chu'Ha'lu'. 'a'baqa' pongmey wa'DIch pollu', Hoq 'ej chagh lo'lu'DI' je.

lo' DachoHmeH, mI' chu'moHghach leQDaq nIH yI'uy, pagh Dotlh tlhegh nIH bIngDaq Degh yI'uy. lo' chu'lu'bogh 'ang QIn mach, cha'Daq. Hoq 'ej chagh lo'lu'DI' je lo'lu' lo' wIvlu'pu'bogh, 'ej poH Hoch qawlu'.
help.flatten_content: veylIj 'a'baqa' ngaSwI'Hommey ngaSchugh, mIlloghmey Hoch patlh rapDaq DavIHmoHmeH « 'a'baqa' ngaSwI'mey beQmoH » yIlo'.
help.viewer_content:
leghwI' DapoSmoHmeH tenwalDaq cha'logh yI'uy:
• ← → leQmey: tenwalmey joj DalengmeH
• D leQ: laDmeH lo'mey loS joj DachoHmeH
  - wa' tenwal: tenwal wa' neH 'anglu'
  - cha' tenwal: tenwal 1 mob, ghIq 2-3, 4-5, latlh je
  - cha' tenwal taHbogh: tenwal 1 mob, ghIq 2-3, 3-4, 4-5, latlh je
  - Webtoon: mIlloghmey chongbogh (weQmoQnaQ mIllogh mIrmey) laDlu'meH, juchghach 900 px vuSlu'; tenwalDaq Dung bIng vIHmoH rutlhHom, ghIq tenwal yor pagh pIrmuS DaSIchDI', tenwal choH
• rutlhHom: nom tenwalmey joj DalengmeH (Webtoon lo'Daq, tenwalDaq Dung bIng vIHmoH)
• Ctrl+rutlhHom joq Ctrl+Plus/Minus: jo' (mIllogh tInghach teH 1000% 'aqroS)
• Ctrl+0: QorwaghvaD jo' lIS
• Ctrl+1: jo' 100% (mIllogh HaStay'mey tInghach teH)
• nIH 'uy + Hoq: QorwaghDaq tIn law'chugh, mIllogh 'anglu'bogh vIHmoH
• F11 leQ: jIH naQ
• cha'logh 'uy: jIH naQ chu' pagh chu'Ha'
• Esc leQ: DaH wevlu'taHbogh qIl (pe'ghach, wanmoHghach, tu'qom wevghach…) pagh leghwI' mej
• laDmeH qoSta': laDmeH qoSta'mey chu'lu'chugh, leghwI' SoQmoHlu'DI' DaH tenwal motlh qawlu' (tenwal wa'DIch, tenwal Qav je, buSHa'lu'). majyang mIlloghDaq, mIllogh mach rapDaq qoSta' Doq 'anglu'. mIllogh paq DapoSmoHqa'DI', tenwalvamvo' DalaDqa'meH QIn 'anglu'. tenwal QavDaq motlh teqlu', pagh leghwI'Daq nIH 'uy lo'taHvIS DateqlaH. motlh laDmeH qoSta'mey chu'Ha'lu'. Dotlh tlhegh nIH bIngDaq qoSta' Degh tu'lu': Deghvam poS yI'uy, laDmeH qoSta'mey Dachu'meH pagh Dachu'Ha'meH (vol HochvaD DuH, poH Hoch pollu'); Deghvam nIH yI'uy, mIllogh paq poSlu'bogh laDmeH qoSta' pagh laDmeH qoSta'mey Hoch DateqmeH. chu'Ha'lu'DI', laDmeH qoSta' lanlu'be' 'ej laDqa'ghach nobbe'lu', 'ach laDmeH qoSta'mey tu'lu'bogh 'anglu'taH majyang mIlloghDaq. vol laDmeH qoSta'mey chu'lu'be'chugh, « laDmeH qoSta'mey chu' » lunob veymey HIDjolev majyang mIllogh nIH 'uy HIDjolev je; chu'lu'chugh, « laDmeH qoSta'mey chu'Ha' » lunob.

SommI'mey tlhegh 'albogh: 'anglu'meH mIllogh yor Dung yIvIH (lup puS pIq So''egh). SommI' Dachu'meH Degh yI'uy:
• pe'ghach: letbaQ yIwev, HeHmeyDaj yIlIS, yIwoq; pe'meH vel lo' Dachu'meH Deghvam nIH yI'uy (« pe'meH vel choq » lo'taHvIS letbaQ yIqaw, ghIq tenwalmey vebDaq « pe'meH vel lo'qa' » lo'taHvIS yIlo'qa' — tenwalmey law' pe'ghach rap Dalo'meH QaQ, letbaQ Dawevqa'be'taHvIS; « pe'meH vel lIj » qawghach teq, tenwal HochvaD neH)
• wanmoHghach: Doch SaSnISbogh/chongnISbogh Dung yamtaw yIwev, motlh choH lo'lu'; wanmoHghach ruQbe'lu'bogh Dachu'meH Deghvam nIH yI'uy (tomghach jem nIqHom, yamtaw DawevnISbe')
• jIrmoHghach/yoymoHghach: 'uy wa', tenwal jIrmoH pagh yoymoH
• voyghach: Hal mIch DawIvmeH Ctrl+'uy, ghIq DaHoqtaHvIS yIDIj, DavoymeH. wevtaHvIS Shift yI'uch: yamtaw wan Daghan, 'ej DajonHa'DI' lo'lu'; pagh 'uy wa'DIch pIq Shift+'uy yIlo', vI' cha' joj SIbI' yamtaw wan DawevmeH
• tlhoD toqwIn: poS 'uy yI'uch 'ej DatlhoDmoHmeH mIchDaq 'eQway' yIvIH (tInghach HoS je mob DalISlaH); Daq rapDaq bIcheghchugh, tlhoD vI'. wevtaHvIS Shift yI'uch: tlhoD yamtaw wan Daghan, 'ej DajonHa'DI' lo'lu'; pagh 'uy wa'DIch pIq Shift+'uy yIlo', vI' cha' joj SIbI' yamtaw wan DawevmeH
• mu'mey: mu'mey ngogh DalanmeH yI'uy; ngutlh tu'qom/tInghach/qalmuS yIwIv
• tu'qommey: gho lang, letbaQ, yamtaw, naQjejHom je yIwev; tInghach DachoHmeH nItSolmey
• SeHwI'mey (Dangghach, wovghach/wov pIm, qalmuS HoS, qalmuS teqghach, qochghach): SeHwI' DaHoqtaHvIS, DaH gher'ID 'anglu'
• patlhmey: qIj vI'/gamma/chIS vI' SeHwI' yIlo', pagh mIlloghvo' qalmuS DaSuqmeH qalmuS SuqwI'mey yIlo'
• Demghach: qalmuS DaDemmoHmeH mIllogh qalmuS yI'uy
• qalmuS patlh, wanI'mey, mIllogh lo': DuH DawIvmeH leQ gho yI'uy; SIbI' lo'lu'
• mIllogh lan: velqa' ngaSwI' mIllogh lan (velqa' ngaSwI' mIllogh ngaSchugh neH Degh chu'lu'); tInghach DachoHmeH pagh DajIrmoHmeH nItSolmey ghaj, tu'qommey rur. majyang mIllogh tenwal joq Windows Explorer 'a'baqa' leghwI'Daq DaHoq 'ej Dachagh je. Ctrl+C: tenwal 'anglu'bogh velqa' chenmoH (wa' tenwal lo' joq Webtoon lo'Daq neH); Ctrl+V: mIllogh lan, majyang mIlloghDaq rur
